subHeading: Train cybersecurity professionals to assess, attack, and secure enterprise AI systems using practical labs and real-world red team exercises.

cards.title: Weekend Live AI Security Training
cards.description: Instructor-led weekend sessions designed for working professionals. Learn AI security, LLM vulnerabilities, prompt injection, AI agents, and enterprise AI security through practical demonstrations and guided exercises.

cards.title: Build Your Own Enterprise AI Lab
cards.description: Configure a complete enterprise AI attack environment from scratch. Deploy LLMs, RAG applications, AI agents, MCP servers, vector databases, and security tools in your own hands-on lab.

cards.title: Real-World AI Red Teaming
cards.description: Practice AI hands-on red teaming using realistic attack scenarios including prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG exploitation, indirect prompt attacks, model abuse, and AI agent security assessments.
